content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancies have been notified separately as backlog/remaining posts under the ESI Scheme Medical Services Department (RPC notification) and as posts reserved for the Kalyana-Karnataka region under Article 371(J) (KK notification).

tables.caption: Vacancy Details - RPC Notification (ESI Scheme Medical Services Department)

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Pharmacy Officer: Must possess a Diploma in Pharmacy from an institution recognized by the Government of Karnataka. Must be registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council. Nursing Officer (RPC notification and ESI department under KK notification): Must possess a Diploma in General Nursing issued by an authority authorized by the Government of Karnataka. Must be registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council. Nursing Officer (Karnataka Residential Educational Institutions Society post under KK notification): Must have passed a B.Sc Nursing degree from a recognized university and institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council/Karnataka State Nursing Council, OR Must have passed PUC or an equivalent examination along with General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) courses from an institution recognized by the Indian Nursing Council/Karnataka State Nursing Council. Candidate must have studied Kannada as a language subject at PG, Bachelor's, PUC, SSLC, or Diploma level, or hold a Kannada certificate (Kavya/Jana/Rathna) issued by the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board or Kannada Sahitya Parishat, Bangalore. Age is calculated as of the last date fixed for submission of the online application. Additional age relaxation of up to 10 years is available for certain government/local authority/central government employees, and specific relaxations apply for ex-servicemen, NCC full-time instructors, Grameena Kutumba Palakas, and widows, as detailed in the official notification. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for two years from the date of joining and are eligible for the National Pension Scheme (NPS) benefit.

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fees must be paid online only, and once paid are non-refundable. Candidates should verify their eligibility, qualification, age limit, and category before paying the fee.

content_sections.heading: KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a competitive written examination conducted in online (CBT) or offline (OMR) mode, as decided by KEA. The exam consists of two papers: Each question carries 4 alternative answers; candidates must mark only one correct answer. Negative marking applies: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer. Candidates must score a minimum of 35% marks in the competitive examination to qualify. Candidates scoring below the minimum marks will be disqualified. A Kannada language test (SSLC-standard, 150 objective-type marks, minimum 50 marks required to pass) applies to candidates who have not studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC/higher level, or who have not already cleared the "Kadaya Kannada" test conducted earlier. Candidates who fail to secure the minimum required marks or remain absent are disqualified from the recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is KEA Pharmacy Officer & Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Karnataka Examinations Authority to fill Group-C posts of Pharmacy Officer and Nursing Officer across the ESI Scheme Medical Services Department and, under a separate Kalyana-Karnataka notification, allied departments.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 233 vacancies are notified - 188 under the RPC notification and 45 under the Kalyana-Karnataka notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted until 30.08.2026, and the fee can be paid until 31.08.2026

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Pharmacy registered with the Karnataka Pharmacy Council is required for Pharmacy Officer. A Diploma in General Nursing (or B.Sc Nursing/PUC+GNM for the KREIS post) registered with the Karnataka Nursing Council is required for Nursing Officer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The general age limit is 18 to 40 years, with relaxation up to 43 years for Category 2A/2B/3A/3B and up to 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1 candidates, as of the last date of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: ₹750 for general and other categories, ₹500 for SC/ST/Category-1/Ex-servicemen/Third gender, and ₹250 for PWD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the KEA official website, https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/, between 07.08.2026 and 30.08.2026.
